samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The input dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The input divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Indicates the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_WIDTH">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="IDLE">3'd0</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">3'd1</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">3'd2</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_dividend" width_description="[8:0]">The absolute value of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">The absolute value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">The result of the subtraction.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out">The carry-out from the subtraction.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]">The selected result from the mux.</signal>
        <signal id="sr_next" width_description="[15:0]">The next state of the shift register.</signal>
        <signal id="shift_reg" width_description="[15:0]">The shift register to store the result.</signal>
        <signal id="remainder" width_description="[7:0]">The remainder of the division.</signal>
        <signal id="quotient" width_description="[7:0]">The quotient of the division.</signal>
        <signal id="counter" width_description="[2:0]">The counter for tracking the number of iterations.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt">A signal to indicate the start of the division process.</signal>
        <signal id="done">A signal to indicate the completion of the division process.</signal>
        
        <assign abs_dividend = {1'b0, dividend[7], dividend}};
        <assign abs_divisor = {1'b0, divisor[7], divisor}};
        <assign neg_divisor = ~abs_divisor + 1;
        <assign sr_next = {SR[14:0], carry_out};
        <assign done = (counter == COUNTER_WIDTH);
        <assign res_valid = (counter == COUNTER_WIDTH && !start_cnt);
        <assign result = {remainder, quotient};
        <assign remainder = shift_reg[15:8];
        <assign quotient = shift_reg[7:0];
        <assign counter = cnt;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State machine states
        typedef enum logic [2:0] {
            IDLE,
            DIVIDE,
            OUTPUT
        } state_t;
        state_t current_state, next_state;
        // Registers for storing inputs
        reg [7:0] dividend_reg, divisor_reg;
        reg sign_reg;
        // Internal signals
        reg [8:0] neg_divisor;
        reg [8:0] abs_dividend;
        reg [8:0] abs_divisor;
        reg [9:0] sub_result;
        reg carry_out;
        reg [9:0] mux_out;
        reg [15:0] shift_reg;
        reg [2:0] counter;
        reg start_cnt;
        // Sequential logic for state transitions and data storage
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
                dividend_reg <= 8'h00;
                divisor_reg <= 8'h00;
                sign_reg <= 1'b0;
                shift_reg <= 16'h0000;
                counter <= 3'b000;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                
                case(current_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                            dividend_reg <= dividend;
                            divisor_reg <= divisor;
                            sign_reg <= sign;
                            shift_reg <= {abs_dividend, 8'h00}; // Shift dividend left by 8 bits
                            start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    DIVIDE: begin
                        if (!done) begin
                            shift_reg <= sr_next;
                            counter <= counter + 1;
                            start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    OUTPUT: begin
                        counter <= 3'b000;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        // Combinational logic for calculations
        always @(*) begin
            next_state = current_state;
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                        abs_dividend = {1'b0, dividend[7], dividend};
                        abs_divisor = {1'b0, divisor[7], divisor};
                        neg_divisor = ~abs_divisor + 1;
                        counter = 3'b001;
                        start_cnt = 1'b1;
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end
                end
                
                DIVIDE: begin
                    if (!done) begin
                        sub_result = shift_reg[15:8] + neg_divisor;
                        carry_out = sub_result[9]; // Carry-out is the 9th bit
                        mux_out = (carry_out) ? sub_result : {1'b0, shift_reg[15:8]};
                        shift_reg = sr_next;
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = OUTPUT;
                    end
                end
                
                OUTPUT: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
